description: Search the Peppol Directory (directory.peppol.eu, OpenPEPPOL's opt-in business-card index) by company name, VAT/organisation number or country to find a participant identifier. Use this to turn a company name into the "{schemeCode}:{value}" identifier that lookup_participant needs. Registration on the network does not require publishing a business card, so absence here is not proof a company is not on Peppol — confirm with lookup_participant.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code filter, e.g. "NO", "BE", "DE".

q.description: Free-text query: company name, VAT number, or organisation number, e.g. "Atelier OSLO" or "1021916675".

name: search_participants
title: Search Participants
